feedback_summary: The candidate provides a well-structured and authentic response that fully addresses the prompt. The letter includes all necessary structural elements, although the student added an unnecessary redundant address section at the bottom. The score is placed at the lower end of Band 4 due to consistent lapses in basic mechanics, specifically the failure to capitalize the pronoun 'I' and a few spelling/syntax slips.
